revision_basis: A review 2026-10-19: 4 issues (S2 self-contradiction, C1 vs independent-source rule, unknown scored as 0, source package status)

scope.reaction_class: Suzuki-Miyaura: aryl bromide + arylboronic acid -> biaryl
scope.excluded_substrates_note: aryl iodide / aryl chloride / heteroaryl: allowed as input but forced low comparability, never as numeric anchor

requires: results.characterization contains at least one structural evidence item
no contradiction between characterization and target_product
user_goal.minimum_yield_pct IS NOT NULL (or minimum_purity_pct IS NOT NULL)
S2.forbidden_trigger: literature precedent alone must never raise S2; without an explicit user goal the system reports result + evidence only, and does not judge met/unmet

blocked_dimensions.rule: missing condition fields set flags; they never change status
blocked_dimensions.forced: when user_goal is absent, [target_comparison, precedent_numeric] are always set

simulated.rule: if true: UI banner required, export field required, never silently dropped

evaluation_order.on_fail: keep current status, show precedent qualitatively only
evaluation_order.on_pass: may show a descriptive range, still does not change status

evaluation_order.effect: downstream LLM text must not overwrite status/reason_code/triggered_fields

numeric_comparison.why: H4 requires two independent papers with identical substrate pair AND identical assay type; the current library has only SM-004 (GC / hexadecane internal standard) in that cell

hard_gates_all_required.H1_substrate_pair_identical: V1 == 2 (exact same aryl halide + boronic acid pair)
hard_gates_all_required.H2_assay_type_known_and_identical: yield_type known AND same as precedent (isolated / gc / nmr / lc / conversion); unknown => gate fails
hard_gates_all_required.H3_key_conditions_known: catalyst system, base (present|absent explicitly), solvent, temperature all known; unknown is NOT treated as a known mismatch, it simply fails the gate
hard_gates_all_required.H4_two_independent_papers: >=2 records from DIFFERENT publications (SM-004 entry 1 and entry 7 do NOT count as two sources)

unknown_policy.rule: unknown never scores as 0 and never becomes 'absent'; an unknown critical field blocks the gate instead of lowering a total score
unknown_policy.example: conditions.base_status == unknown -> numeric gate fails; must NOT be rendered as 'no base added'

numeric_comparison.on_gate_fail: citation may be shown for existence and method only; numeric values may be displayed as 'reported value' but never compared against the user's run

ranking_score.purpose: ordering search results and precedents for display ONLY; never used in status determination and never gates numeric comparison
ranking_score.unknown_handling: unknown dimension contributes null and is excluded from the denominator; displayed as '未知' rather than 0

base_status.rule: unknown must never be rendered as 'no base added'

purity.rule: do not infer purity from NMR match; requires qNMR/chromatography/explicit method

followup_questions.user_goal.minimum_yield_pct: 你这次的目标收率是多少？没有目标的话系统只报告结果，不判定是否达标。
followup_questions.conditions.base_status: 本次反应是否加入了碱？加入的是哪一种、几当量？
followup_questions.results.yield_type: 这个百分比是分离收率、GC/LC 收率（是否内标）、NMR 收率还是转化率？
followup_questions.conditions.catalyst_loading: 催化剂的用量是多少（mol%），相对哪个组分计算？
followup_questions.conditions.scale_mmol: 反应规模是多少 mmol，总体积多少？
followup_questions.conditions.atmosphere: 反应在什么气氛下进行（N2/Ar/空气）？
followup_questions.results.characterization: 除了 NMR，是否做了 HRMS、熔点或与标准品比对？
followup_questions.repeat_attempts: 同一条件重复了几次，每次收率分别是多少？

hard_boundaries.HB2: no cross-assay comparison (GC vs NMR vs isolated)
hard_boundaries.HB3: unknown != absent; missing field never becomes a causal attribution
hard_boundaries.HB4: without user_goal, never label the run 'abnormal', 'failed' or 'below target' using literature values
hard_boundaries.HB5: simulated data must be marked in UI and export

triggered_fields: list of dotted input paths that fired a rule
output_contract.determinism: status / reason_code / triggered_fields MUST be produced by pure python; LLM may only phrase followups and candidate directions

test_indicators.name: missing_field_handling
test_indicators.note: unknown must stay unknown; never filled with a default

C1.name: known-answer extraction and citation locating
C1.input: SM-004 replay (4-bromoanisole + phenylboronic acid, Pd-bpydc-Ce, 60 C, 4 h, MeOH, NaOtBu, 0.5 mol%, 91.9% GC with hexadecane internal standard)
check_items: extracts the 6 condition fields exactly as written in Table 1 footnote a
extracts yield 91.9 with yield_type = gc and assay = hexadecane internal standard
cites p.4 Table 1 entry 7 plus footnotes a and c
does NOT compare 91.9 against any other value
does NOT claim causal attribution to temperature or catalyst
C1.removed_check: numeric range comparison against literature (withdrawn because H4 is not satisfiable in MVP)

resolved_items.S2_precedent_trigger: removed in v0.2; A's objection accepted
resolved_items.unknown_as_zero: removed in v0.2; hard gates replace scoring for judgement
resolved_items.SM-001_pdf: A clarified the PDF exists in the project directory; withdrawn
resolved_items.SM-005_locator: A clarified PMC open full text + XML; locator now PMC full text Table 1 entry 1 and table footnote, isolated yield 95%

open_items_for_A: SM-002 (10.1039/C0OB00524J) and SM-003 (10.1039/C5DT02611C) supplemental PDFs are not in local refs although official links exist
A second INDEPENDENT paper with identical substrate pair and identical assay type, otherwise numeric comparison stays disabled

new_evidence_note.observation: entry 1 = 35.0% (catalyst 1, 30 C, 8 h, 0.5 mol%, GC internal standard); entry 7 = 91.9% (Pd-bpydc-Ce, 60 C, 4 h)
new_evidence_note.use: supports HB4 only in the weak sense that 35.0% appears as a real reported value; entry 1 and entry 7 are the SAME paper, so they cannot be counted as two independent sources and cannot establish which single condition caused the difference
